{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id, *before* removing QC-failed rows
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]
print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication (before QC filter): {len(data_dedup)}')

# Final count of enrolled patients — all patients who were enrolled, regardless of assay quality
num_patients_enrolled = len(data_dedup)
num_patients_enrolled"}
